title: SHUCKED – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: SHUCKED Broadway Musical – Great Southern Bank Season
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical comedy where you watch Maizy and Beau's wedding plans collide with a crisis, as the corn protecting their small community starts to die and someone must venture beyond Cob County for answers. The show features songs including "Woman of the World," "Somebody Will" and "Independently Owned." It is recommended for ages 10+ and contains adult themes, some adult language and corny innuendo; the on-sale date for tickets is still to be announced.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
